MENTOR: Tile, Caption and Stamp are your group.

On Hatch Rig: I can see that Hatch follows it, but I can't tell whether Hatch Rig has keys or when they'd be, so I can't show you its move. If you scrub the timeline with Hatch Rig selected and press U, you'll see any keys it has. It works the same way you're about to build here.

That's the frame at 0 s. It's mostly the purple background, so I can't point anything out in it.

The idea is that once Tile, Caption and Stamp follow one parent, whatever that parent does to its position, scale or rotation carries all three, and each one keeps its own animation. A null is the best parent for this because it never shows in the render. Two things to keep in mind:
- **Children inherit position, scale and rotation, but not opacity or effects.** Fading the parent doesn't fade the group.
- **A null is invisible**, so it can't add anything to the group's look.

Your turn: add a null with **Layer > New > Null Object**. Where should the group turn or scale from? It could be a corner, the middle of an edge, or the middle of the group. If it'll only slide, that's a fine answer too.
